answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 43552 Country: India Title: Name Question: By the blessings of Almighty Allah, I got a new born baby girl. I want to keep her name as "SARAH SAJID". Is it permissible as per Shariah? One of my friend said, SARAH is a Christian name. Is he right? Answer ID: 43552 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 249/164/L=1434) You can name your daughter Sara. It is good name. It is the name of the wife of Hadhrat Ebrahim (عليه السلام), it is not correct to consider it a Christian name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
